title: snapshot.snapshot_origin payload
description: M4 § M9 firehose surface (deep damage). Placeholder payload at M4 (placeholder=true); M9/M17 fills by_actor with origin reaction state. Fires at scenario start and on every objective transition.

placeholder.description: True when emitted by M4 with a stub payload; M9/M17 producer fills real data and clears this flag.

by_actor.description: Per-actor origin reaction state: { actor_id, origin_id: Human|Android|Robot|PoweredOrganic|Construct|HeavyBioMech, g_load_dose, oxygen_supply_s (humans + androids), helmet_seal_intact (humans + androids) }.
